messages:
Alli (People Ops): uploaded handbook update 'Emergency & Travel-Disruption Leave' — please quick review for retro-pay language and manager ack flow.

Marco (Eng Manager): skimmed. retro-pay window? any examples for documentation?

Alli (People Ops): added Section 3.2: retro-pay eligible within 30 days with manager + People Ops signoff. Acceptable docs: itineraries, carrier disruption notices, or short signed statements. Examples included.

Sara (EU HR): added EU appendix with per-country notice notes and links. Also suggested localized manager checklist. Link: https://notion.redwood/company-handbook/emergency-leave

Jon (Hiring Ops): rollout plan: manager-level acks in two waves — wave 1 managers with >5 directs, wave 2 everyone else. I can export CSV and send tokenized ack links. Reminder cadence: day 0, day 3, day 7.

Alli (People Ops): perfect. require managers to watch one 20-min recorded briefing (we'll record two times for EMEA/APAC). Ack target: complete in 10 business days; if wave A <60% escalate to leads.

Marco (Eng Manager): can ack links auto-log to People Ops sheet? saves manual work.

Jon (Hiring Ops): yes — will param manager_id in link and webhook updates tracking sheet. Will attach CSV to People Ops drive, schedule reminders.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Handbook update: Emergency & Travel-Disruption Leave — Manager ack due in 10d" — sending wave 1 in 5 minutes.

Alli (People Ops): action items: Sara finish EU appendix EOD, Jon run exports + reminders, Marco send any edge cases by EOD. I'll publish company note after wave A hits 60%.

Marco (Eng Manager): acknowledged, will DM edge cases now. :thumbsup:
